linkedin.title: We decided to stop optimizing our feed for time spent.
linkedin.body:
Most news apps are designed to keep you scrolling as long as possible. They prioritize engagement metrics above all else. But we took a different path when building the Headlinne feed. We decided to optimize for relevance instead of duration.

This meant changing how our AI selects stories. Instead of showing you the most sensational content that might keep you clicking, it looks for the topics you actually care about. If you finish reading a story, we consider that a success. We want you to feel informed, not addicted.

It is a counterintuitive engineering choice. By design, it means you might spend less time in the app. But we believe that quality news consumption is better than endless scrolling. When the goal is to save you time rather than steal it, the product naturally becomes more useful.

story.title: Apple unveils folding iPhone Duo as new CEO takes center stage
story.summary: The passport-size iPhone Duo serves as the first big test for John Ternus, who took over for Tim Cook last week Apple has unveiled the iPhone Duo, the company’s first foldable phone and the most significant change to the iPhone since the smartphone’s introduction in 2007. The nearly $2,000 device takes inspiration from iPads’ wide screens and combines them with the portability and camera features of iPhones. When opened, it is the company’s largest phone display and thinnest phone. The Duo opens and closes like a passport to double its screen size. Continue reading...
